newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman cuts Nordstrom.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman cuts Nordstrom.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs said Monday it lowered its rating of Nordstrom Inc to market perform from outperform.
-- Goldman said it cut its 1996 earnings view on Nordstrom to $1.95 a share from $2.10 a share. Goldman cut the 1997 earnings forecast to $2.35 a share from $2.55 a share.
-- After the market closed on Friday, Nordstrom said its holiday same-store sales declined from last year and that its fourth quarter earnings would be below Wall Street expectations.
